title: Tiny, cute pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body, tilted -->
  <g transform='rotate(-25 50 50)'>
    <!-- wooden body -->
    <rect x='36' y='20' width='28' height='52' rx='4' fill='#F6C445'/>
    <!-- lighter highlight stripe -->
    <rect x='36' y='20' width='8' height='52' rx='3' fill='#FFE08A'/>
    <!-- side shading -->
    <rect x='58' y='20' width='6' height='52' rx='2' fill='#D99A1E'/>
    <!-- metal ferrule -->
    <rect x='35' y='14' width='30' height='12' rx='3' fill='#B8C4D4'/>
    <rect x='35' y='16' width='30' height='3' fill='#E4EBF5'/>
    <!-- eraser -->
    <rect x='37' y='4' width='26' height='12' rx='5' fill='#F28BA8'/>
    <rect x='37' y='4' width='9' height='12' rx='5' fill='#FFB6C9'/>
    <!-- sharpened wood cone -->
    <polygon points='36,72 64,72 50,90' fill='#F0D2A0'/>
    <polygon points='36,72 45,72 50,90' fill='#FFF0D8'/>
    <!-- graphite tip -->
    <polygon points='45,82 55,82 50,90' fill='#6E5AA8'/>
    <!-- cute face on body -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='42' r='3' fill='#4A3A7A'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='3' fill='#4A3A7A'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <path d='M46 50 Q51 55 56 50' stroke='#4A3A7A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#F6A0B8' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#F6A0B8' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
